uncited: **Matrix Construction:** Build a model-view matrix from the volume orientation quaternion and the zoom factor.
Combine this with the projection matrix to form a 4x4 modelview-projection matrix.

**Upper Threshold Optimization:** If an upper intensity threshold exists above which all voxels have maximum intensity, project all such voxels in a single call to `glDrawArrays` using point primitives.
